title: In 1895, a Train Smashed Through a Paris Station Wall and Fell 30 Feet

scenes.text: In 1895, a train drove straight out of a Paris station.
Its air brake failed, and it was running late, so it was going too fast.
It smashed through the buffer, crossed the concourse and broke through a thick wall.
The engine dropped about thirty feet to the street and landed on its nose.
All 131 passengers lived. One woman on the street was killed by falling stone.
A train, standing on its nose, in the middle of Paris.

description:
On 22 October 1895 the Granville-Paris express overran the end of the track at Gare Montparnasse.
It broke through a wall and fell to the street below.
Have you seen the famous photo?
